description: Signalisation verticale is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Localisation des supports de la signalisation verticale permanente, et types de panneaux et panonceaux associés. Pour en savoir plus sur la typologie des panneaux de signalisation: cliquez ici Point d'attention: cette donnée est issue d'un relevé sur plusieurs années. Des décalages peuvent ainsi apparaître. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are panneaux, signalisation verticale, signalisation, verticale. The portal shows 45,594 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
